posts.title: v0.18 — Pixel Art and Card Descriptions
posts.message: New pixel-art cards and sleeves, shop tabs for Cards, Sleeves, and Unique items, and card descriptions shown by tapping and holding a visible card.

posts.title: v0.17 — Consistent Menus
posts.message: Updated menu screens with a consistent space background and navigation style. Main menu buttons now appear in one vertical column, with improved spacing and scrolling on smaller screens.

posts.title: v0.16 — Main Menu Refresh and Code Cleanup
posts.message: Added a new main menu background and simple white-text buttons. Cleaned up existing code to improve readability while preserving gameplay.

posts.title: v0.15 — News Feed and Changelog
posts.message: Upcoming news now appears above the latest three released updates in a scrollable changelog. Preserved flexible dates, custom status text, and offline news.
